description: This file defines the feature for creating comments in the application. It includes the data records, validation logic, and the request handler that processes the creation of a comment linked to an article.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the comment body is not empty.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of a new comment associated with an article, including validation, database interaction, and response packaging.

methods.name: Create.Handler.Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the command to create a comment, throws an exception if article not found, and returns the created comment envelope.
